  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e direcionar clientes, oferecendo um serviço cortês e eficiente;
  • Consultoria de Vendas: Oferecer informações detalhadas sobre os produtos, suas características, preços e garantias durante o processo de vendas;
  • Manutenção do Ambiente de Trabalho: Manter o ambiente de trabalho limpo, organizado e seguro.

title: Tax Specialist
description:
Responsibilities

  4. Languages:Fluent in Portuguese and English.

title: Sales Manager [Distributor and EPC]
description:
GoodWe is looking for a Sales Manager to expand and strengthen relationships with solar retail distributors and EPCs in Brazil. This position is responsible for managing strategic customers, driving channel development, and ensuring operational excellence. Your mission as a Sales Manager is to achieve established sales targets, optimize channel operations, and implement strategic account planning while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This is a remote position based in Brazil. You will work closely with the pre-sales, after-sales, and marketing teams, as well as collaborate with the internal sales team at the company's headquarters.

Main responsibilities

  • Sell into the whole portfolio of inverters, batteries and accessories in the residential, C&I, and utility market segments.
  • Responsible for the operation and implementation of effective business development measures to ensure the promotion and generation of sales in accordance with company policies.
  • Taking actions to resolve complex problems, implement measures to achieve cost savings and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Increase the distributors volume across all product lines (inverters, storage, etc.).
  • Setup business development plan and action plans by account.
  • Identify, drive and pursue new business opportunities with different distributors, wholesalers, resellers, installers by selecting appropriate products enablers.
  • Manage business opportunities and deliver recognized value to customers that will generate profit and continuous growth for GoodWe.
  • Identify Distributor sales requirements/gaps and work on a solution.
  • Develop and maintain an understanding of target customers and markets, as well as industry/channel issues, and customer purchasing behavior and influences. Obtain, evaluate and communicate such market-customer-channel & competitor behavior information.
  • Work with his sales team and jointly with Pre-sales, After-sales, and Marketing teams to establish and implement business plan objectives.
  • Provide portfolio, channel policy, and campaigns presentations to distributor, resellers, and installers.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, installers, distributors, EPCs and Investors.
  • Work with CRM for the best outcome.

Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering-related field is preferred.
  • Business development expertise with a proven sales track record with Tier-1 companies.
  • Professional experience in working with PV solar inverters preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, relationship management qualities, and leadership abilities.
  • Strong goal orientation and closing mindset.
  • Proven ability to articulate the value proposition of solutions and to differentiate against competitors.
  • Able to work with a high degree of independence.
  • We expect an enthusiastic team player, willing to communicate across departments.

  • Proven customer focus with bottom line in mind.
  • Availability to travel 50% of each month.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.

:

Com larga experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos de Construção e Montagem, cuja complexidade demanda alta especialização para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e segurança nos resultado, atua nos seguintes setores:

✔ Petróleo e Gás

✔ Naval

✔ Química e Petroquímica

✔ Termoeletricidade

✔ Bioenergia

✔ Siderurgia & Metalurgia

A Enseada é um dos maiores investimentos privados da Bahia nos últimos anos, sendo o veículo que consolidou todo o conhecimento e expertise dos seus acionistas no segmento de construção naval e offshore . Com tecnologia Kawasaki Heavy Industries, a Enseada foi implantada estrategicamente às margens do Rio Paraguaçu, no Estado da Bahia. Além disso, não há concorrência de atracação com outras indústrias como em outras regiões. Gerando emprego e renda para a região do recôncavo baiano, o local é reconhecido como celeiro de grandes projetos offshore desde a década de 1980.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the job

1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Elaborar cronogramas e planos de limpeza, definindo a frequência de limpeza para diferentes áreas (diária, semanal, etc.).Identificar áreas que exigem limpeza especial ou mais detalhada, como banheiros, áreas comuns, etc.

e extravios. Realiza limpeza de máquinas,
equipamentos, ferramentas, por meio da observação de resíduos, óleo, água,
entre outros e higienização das impurezas encontradas, tendo em vista
zelar pelo bom estado e conservação dos mesmos. Conhece e aplica os requisitos
de Boas Práticas de Fabricação de acordo com a legislação aplicável,
cumprindo os procedimentos internos em seu setor. Participa de treinamentos
relacionados aos procedimentos de BPF. Reporta
problemas relacionados a desvios de BPF ao superior imediato para tomada
de ações, contribuindo para a erradicação das não conformidades; Participar da investigação da anomalia de SST,
quando designado; Quando ocorrer; Garantir que os riscos sejam reduzidos ao

legais; Contínuo. Para NR 12: A função citada

11: Foi autorizado utilizar, em formato de painel, as informações

title: Gerente Sênior de Engenharia (Setor Naval)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Gerente Sênior de Engenharia (Setor Naval). Este/a profissional atuará na elaboração e execução de projetos de engenharia para a construção de embarcações do tipo Offshore Support Vessel (PSVs, OSRVs e RSVs) numa parceria entre a Tenenge (marca pertencente a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, especializada em projetos industriais) e o Estaleiro Enseada (complexo naval de projetos de construção, reparo e manutenção naval e offshore pertencente ao grupo Novonor) . Este/a profissional terá estas atribuições principais:


  • Liderar a equipe de engenharia na elaboração de projetos para a construção de embarcações tipo PSV, OSRV e RSV;
  • Garantir que todos os projetos sejam executados conforme o planejamento, dentro dos prazos e orçamento estabelecidos;
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos, seguindo as normas e regulamentos do setor naval;
  • Coordenar com outras áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos projetos;
  • Realizar análises técnicas e fornecer soluções inovadoras para desafios de engenharia;
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos técnicos e operacionais;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor naval, aplicando melhores práticas nos projetos;
  • Gerenciar a comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo clientes, fornecedores e parceiros internacionais.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência profissional no setor naval;
  • Desejável que este/a profissional possua experiência em projetos internacionais no setor naval;
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes;
  • Alta capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos e tomada decisões estratégicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação;
  • Necessário possuir inglês fluente.



Sobre a Tenenge :


A Tenenge, marca pertencente a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, atua no segmento de Plantas Industriais de forma integrada, reunindo capacidade técnica, gerencial e financeira para executar o ciclo completo de empreendimentos de grande porte em regime de EPC e EPCM, em qualquer parte do mundo.

Com larga experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos de Construção e Montagem, cuja complexidade demanda alta especialização para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e segurança nos resultado, atua nos seguintes setores:


✔ Petróleo e Gás

✔ Naval

✔ Química e Petroquímica

✔ Termoeletricidade

✔ Bioenergia

✔ Siderurgia & Metalurgia

✔ Papel & Celulose



Sobre a Enseada:


A Enseada é um dos maiores investimentos privados da Bahia nos últimos anos, sendo o veículo que consolidou todo o conhecimento e expertise dos seus acionistas no segmento de construção naval e offshore . Com tecnologia Kawasaki Heavy Industries, a Enseada foi implantada estrategicamente às margens do Rio Paraguaçu, no Estado da Bahia. O estaleiro está localizado em águas abrigadas e com calado profundo, onde não há a incidência de correnteza ou ventos inesperados. Além disso, não há concorrência de atracação com outras indústrias como em outras regiões. Gerando emprego e renda para a região do recôncavo baiano, o local é reconhecido como celeiro de grandes projetos offshore desde a década de 1980.

title: Gerente Regional Comercial - AS
description:
O Grupo Petrópoli s é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 190 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversida de.

  • Garantir a melhoria da rentabilidade e do atendimento ao canal, por meio da análise e gerenciamento dos relatórios de oportunidades de incremento de vendas das contas na região de atuação nacionais e regionais, verificando produtos potenciais que não estão sendo comercializados, da aprovação das propostas de ações e de visitas periódicas nas matrizes e células dos clientes.


  • Assegurar a ativação de produtos do portfólio em canais onde não estão presentes, através da validação do calendário promocional semestral e anual, analisando as ações em pontos de vendas, eventos, mídias, entre outros.

  • Reduzir o percentual de inadimplência e assegurar os compromissos acordados em contrato, por meio da análise, gerenciamento e controle do consolidado mensal dos pagamentos, abatimentos e inadimplências das carteiras de clientes da região de atuação e do acompanhamento da negociação em tabloides, ações promocionais e pricing, visando que a negociação realizada na região de atuação seja cumprida pelas regionais.

title: Tax Specialist
description:
Responsibilities

  1. Analyze procurement processes under different scenarios from a tax perspective, establish and optimize business rules such as supplier price selection criteria and quotation structures, and be responsible for training relevant departments on implementation.

  4. Tax Burden Reduction – Analyze procurement processes to identify legal opportunities for tax savings (such as interstate rate differences or tax benefits); evaluate the impact of import taxes (II, IPI) and optimize procurement strategies.
  5. Cross-Department Collaboration – Support procurement and finance teams in analyzing supplier tax risks; provide tax training to facilitate understanding of Brazil’s complex tax system.
  6. Regulatory Updates – Monitor changes in Brazilian tax legislation and adjust procurement strategies to mitigate risks.


Qualifications

  1. Education: Fields of study: Finance, Taxation, or related areas.
  2. Experience:At least 3 years of experience in Brazilian taxation, with preference for candidates having experience in procurement-related taxes and/or working experience at Big Four firms.
  3. Skills:Proficiency in Brazilian tax legislation;Knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
  4. Languages:Fluent in Portuguese and English.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the job


1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.
